part2.question: Describe a new skill you learned when you were a child

segments.v: I want to talk about how I learned to ride a bicycle when I was six years old. My grandfather taught me. He lived with my family at that time. We practised in the small alley near my house because there were not many cars. First I used a bike with small wheels. Then my grandfather took off the small wheels. He ran behind me and held the seat. I fell down many times and my knees were hurt. I cried and I wanted to stop. But my grandfather encouraged me. One day he let go of the seat and I rode alone. I was very surprised and happy. I feel very happy about learning this skill. Now I can ride a bike to school. I am thankful to my grandfather because he was very patient.

I'd like to talk about learning to ride a bicycle, which I did when I was about six. My grandfather taught me. At the time, my grandparents lived with us in our old house in Đống Đa, and there was a long, narrow alley outside, which was perfect for practising because there was hardly any traffic.
